messages:
Jordan (eng-platform): Heads up — we're seeing per-invocation costing drift on the new cost dashboard. Sampled invocations + routing overrides mean the sum on the per-invocation pane != ledger by ~2-3% for large tenants. Example: https://dash.redwood/api/preview?id=tokenline-xyz (screenshot attached)
Priya (eng-ml): Hmm — is this the batch-level attribution bug we saw earlier? can you paste the example span id + raw events?
Jordan (eng-platform): span: 0a3f... log: "route=stable->canary override=true sample=0.1 batch_id=b_2026_03_20_03". When override=true we attribute all tokens to the override route but the ledger applies to original route because it billed before fallback.
Li (eng-releases): Oh yeah that flow is subtle. Two sources of mismatch: sampling bias + attribution time (pre-routing vs post-routing). We should reconcile at commit time and keep provenance. :thinking:
Marta (product): UX ask — can we show "estimated" vs "finalized" costs in the console with a small confidence band? PMs want to see early signals without confusing finance.
Priya (eng-ml): Proposal: run a reconcile job per billing window that replays sampled events and adjusts per-invocation cards. Keep UI optimistic: show estimate = streaming attribution, then tag delta after reconcile job completes. API: GET /costs/invocation?estimate=true|final=true
Jordan (eng-platform): Implementation note: we currently only store 'route_hint' in the router logs. Need to persist 'canonical_route' and 'billing_route' at request end. Pseudo-SQL:

```
UPDATE invocations SET billing_route = COALESCE(billing_route, computed_billing_route)
WHERE batch_id = :batch
```

Then a reconcile job compares billing_route to shown_route and emits adjustments.
Li (eng-releases): How much extra storage/ingest are we comfortable with? storing per-invocation billing_route for every sampled event could be heavy.
Priya (eng-ml): We can compress: only store the 8-byte route fingerprint + batch pointer. sample rate 1% -> extra ~100GB/month on hot table, but we'll TTL after finalization.
Marta (product): For rollout UX: add a toggle 'apply-reconciled-deltas' for early adopters. Default off. Also show a changelog entry when numbers move.
Jordan (eng-platform): Also an alert: if reconcile delta > 1% for a tenant, create an ops ticket to investigate routing policy skews.
infra-bot: deploy triggered: reconcile-job v0.5 -> staging at 1769999999
Li (eng-releases): For API semantics, prefer separate endpoints: /costs/invocation/estimate and /costs/invocation/final to avoid query flags.
Priya (eng-ml): Agreed. I'll sketch API + DB migration plan. Will post a short RFC in #eng-platform by EOD. Thanks!
Jordan (eng-platform): Awesome, landing this into the cost dashboard roadmap. :thumbsup:
